researcher_notes: CALIBRATION RUN. Single 2-page flyer for an existing DB product (Hikrobot F3-1500, forklift/pallet-mover class AGV). Kept deliberately small/simple as the 8th and final unit of this calibration batch. Two conflicts found against already-filled DB fields, neither overwritten. ADDENDUM (full-batch continuation run, same calendar day): STU_flyer_eng_cemat_v2.pdf processed, revealing a genuinely NEW Hikrobot product line (STU Series, tote-shuttle/CTU-class mobile robot for high-density storage, similar in category to Geek+'s RoboShuttle line already in the DB under a different company) not previously covered. 'QF Pallet-handling Mobile Robot_Flyer_2024 Cemat_eng.pdf' (+1 byte-identical duplicate) was attempted but its extracted text is a garbled custom-font-encoding cipher (every character substituted, not a language/OCR issue -- e.g. 'Nutzlast' concepts appear as unreadable symbol strings) that neither plain text nor table extraction could resolve; unlike the Balyo Veeny/REACHY font-garbling cases earlier in this batch (which were readable via image fallback), this one was NOT visually re-read this run due to remaining time budget -- deferred alongside the other large deferred catalogs (Hikrobot full-version brochure, Kivnon catalog, VisionNav catalogs), flagged as a good target for a dedicated future session using image-based extraction from the start. ADDENDUM 2 (final-8-files run, same calendar day): QF flyer read via image-based Read tool per plan (garbled-font file, text extraction skipped entirely this time). Two genuinely new products found: QF-600D and QF-1000D, an underride-style 'latent mobile robot chassis + forklift forks' pallet handler -- classified Mobile AMR by analogy with Hikrobot's own Q-series (underride) naming/classification convention rather than F-series (Forklift AGV), since 'QF' explicitly combines LMR (latent/underride) chassis with FMR forks and the flyer's own text frames it as an LMR-class robot gaining pallet capability, not a forklift gaining AMR features.

max_speed.datasheet_value: 1.5 m/s (p.1 'Key Feature: Efficient Transferring: max. running speed 1.5m/s' and p.2 table 'Running Speed 1.5/1.2m/s')
max_speed.note: Not overwritten. DB value 2.1 m/s does not match either the loaded or unloaded speed printed on this flyer (1.5/1.2 m/s) -- flagged for manual reconciliation, possibly sourced from a different revision or a different Hikrobot model originally.

vehicle_width.note: Not overwritten. Minor 7mm discrepancy, plausibly rounding/tolerance rather than a real spec difference -- flagged for completeness but low-priority for manual review.

products.notes: vehicle_length=1632 and stop_accuracy=10 already match this flyer exactly ('Positioning Accuracy ±10mm') -- confirmed, not restated as new fills. load_detection=Camera/Vision already matches the flyer's 'Pallet Recognition: autonomous fork picking according to the location of the pallet, and can identify the black, stainless steel and other special pallets' (implies vision-based recognition) -- confirmed, no change. drive_type='Pallet Mover' already set and left untouched; the flyer's adaptive-carrier icons (Plastic Pallet / Wooden Pallet / Rack) and 'autonomous fork picking' language are consistent with a fork-based pallet handler but do not by themselves confirm or contradict the specific 'Pallet Mover' (straddle-under-load) sub-classification versus e.g. a reach-truck-style design -- not re-verified in this run. omnidirectional_movement intentionally left null despite 'Flexible movement: forward/backward/arc moving, rotate in place' -- rotate-in-place and arc movement do not by themselves confirm lateral/omnidirectional travel (could be a standard differential/steer drive), so not set to avoid a wrong true.

field_sources.navigation_type: p.2 spec table, 'Navigation Mode Visual' for both sub-models
field_sources.top_module_type: p.1 body text, actuator/clamping mechanism for tote handling ('Proven and reliable CTU clamping, grab components') plus p.2 'Max. Lifting Speed (m/s) 2' -- a lift-type top module

products.notes: NEW PRODUCT (genuinely new product line, not a variant of any existing Hikrobot F/Q-series product -- STU is described as 'the new generation of CTU mobile robots' for tote/shuttle warehousing, structurally different from the F/Q-series pallet-handling forklifts already in the DB). Two sub-model codes (MR-TP6-30SCH / MR-TP6-30SCW) share identical numeric specs except tote-dimension compatibility (different adaptor orientations: 600x400x300mm & 800x600x450mm vs 650x450x300mm) -- treated as ONE product entry rather than two, since the difference is a tote-adaptor configuration, not a distinct capability class (consistent with this batch's AGILOX OCF config-vs-variant reasoning). 'Picking Height(m) 12' (max shelf/rack height the STU system operates within, not a single-vehicle lift stroke) has no clean single-field AP0 mapping and was NOT mapped to lift_height, since lift_height's AP0 definition is a per-vehicle stroke not an installation's overall storage height -- left null rather than force-mapped; noted here for a reviewer's awareness since it's a materially informative figure (max 12m warehouse height) even though it doesn't fit lift_height cleanly. fleet_management_system/integration_capability not stated in this flyer -- left null.

products.notes: Brand confirmed HIKROBOT (logo top-right both pages, 'Hikrobotics.com' footer). Two-model table (QF-600D / QF-1000D) is a genuine variant pair, not a config matrix to collapse -- both entered as separate products per the variant-completion rule. 'Roadway Width (mm) ≥1800' (Motion Performance section) has no clean AP0 field match for the AMR scope (min_aisle_width only exists under Logistics:AGV:Forklift scope, not AMR) -- left unmapped, noted here for reviewer awareness since it is a real published spec. 'Applicable Pallet Entry/Inner/Outer Width/Length' fields (pallet-fit constraints, not vehicle dimensions) have no AP0 field match -- left unmapped. 'Ground Roller Docking Height ≤200mm' (third-party conveyor interface height) also has no AP0 field match, not min_ground_clearance (different concept -- conveyor docking height, not vehicle ground clearance) -- left unmapped. Drive method 'Differential drive' noted but drive_type field is Forklift-scope only, not applicable here. No radius/diameter turning figure printed on this flyer -- the min_turning_radius open question (see agent memory) does not arise for this product.
